name: Rictavio

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout: Rudolph van Richten in disguise. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The prepared spell list especially needs the book. Undead Slayer is text only for the engine; spell slots are listed per spell.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.summary: Wears a hat of disguise and a ring of mind shielding, and carries a spell scroll of Raise Dead.
traits.text: Besides his sword cane, Rictavio wears a hat of disguise and a ring of mind shielding, and he carries a spell scroll of Raise Dead.

traits.name: Undead Slayer
traits.summary: His weapon hits deal an extra 10 (3d6) damage to Undead.
traits.text: When Rictavio hits an Undead with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage of the weapon's type.

actions.name: Sword Cane
actions.summary: Thrusts with the silvered blade hidden in his cane, or raps with the cane itself.
actions.text: Melee attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage with the silvered blade drawn, or 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage with the wooden cane.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: A 9th-level wizard (Int, DC 16, +8): detection, warding and binding magic rather than blasts.
actions.text: Rictavio casts spells as a 9th-level wizard, using Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). Cantrips (at will): Friends, Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation. 1st level (4 slots): Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Protection from Evil and Good, Sleep. 2nd level (3 slots): Detect Thoughts, Gentle Repose, Hold Person. 3rd level (3 slots): Clairvoyance, Magic Circle, Remove Curse. 4th level (3 slots): Arcane Eye, Banishment, Locate Creature. 5th level (1 slot): Hold Monster.

summary: Van Richten behind a showman's bluster: a silvered sword cane that bites deep into the undead, and a scholar's wizardry.
